Arrows in the Quiver  ·  Women Growing in the Word

These studies are written for women who want to go deeper — into the text, into the theology, into the honest places where Scripture meets real life. Each one is built from the ground up with original research, careful handling of the Word, and the conviction that Jesus is worth every drop of attention we give him.
